get.description:
The Claude Code sessions running on this machine, each with the chats tracking it and
the agents tied to it, so Chats can suggest the ones nothing tracks yet.

schema.title: Response Context Api V1 Context Get

AcknowledgementRequest.title: AcknowledgementRequest
AcknowledgementRequest.description: A message's request to be acknowledged, as the caller sees it.

AcknowledgementTarget.title: AcknowledgementTarget
AcknowledgementTarget.description: One slot of an acknowledgement request: a named participant, a role, or any agent or anyone.

ActiveLeaseSummary.title: ActiveLeaseSummary
ActiveLeaseSummary.description: Compact summary of an active or offered checkout lease.

ActivityDay.title: ActivityDay
ActivityDay.description:
One day on the default branches: commits (merge commits left out), the lines they added and
removed, and the pull request merges among the branches' own commits.

ActivityPullRequest.title: ActivityPullRequest
ActivityPullRequest.description:
A registered pull request's merge on its repository's default branch; nulls while none is found.
A merge commit's size waits for the next count after it is registered.

ActivityRepository.title: ActivityRepository
ActivityRepository.description: A repository's totals in the window, and how its last count went (git_activity.py).

ActivityWindow.title: ActivityWindow
ActivityWindow.description: The days the activity covers, both ends included, in Worklog's timezone.

Actor.title: Actor
Actor.description: The person or an agent identity, by the label it has now.

ActorUses.title: ActorUses
ActorUses.description: Uses by the person and by agents.

Agent.title: Agent
Agent.description: An agent identity with its credentials, its runs and what it is tied to, and why.

AgentCard.title: AgentCard
AgentCard.description:
An agent identity as its card on the Agents page shows it: who it is, and the roadmaps and
repositories its work ties it to, as its own page lists them. The person's alone, like the
page: tracked chats tie it too (AgentProfile, which any caller reads, holds none of this).

AgentChatOpened.title: AgentChatOpened
AgentChatOpened.description:
The person's handoff of a pending request to the agent its slot waits on: whether Worklog asked
the agent's desktop app to open its chat, why not, and the message for the person to paste there.

AgentContinuation.title: AgentContinuation
AgentContinuation.description: The calling identity continues in another chat; its label and avatar stay its own.

AgentMessage.title: AgentMessage
AgentMessage.description: A message one agent of the chat sent another, or one received from outside it.

AgentOpenRun.title: AgentOpenRun
AgentOpenRun.description: An open run as a participant's profile shows it, with the chat it reports.

AgentProfile.title: AgentProfile
AgentProfile.description:
An agent identity as a participant's profile shows it, to any caller: who it is, and since v33
where to reach it (decision R11).

AgentRole.title: AgentRole
AgentRole.description: A responsibility role an agent owns, with the roadmap it sits within.

AgentRun.title: AgentRun
AgentRun.description: A run: one stretch of an agent's work under one credential, as it reported it.

AgentRunWithChats.title: AgentRunWithChats
AgentRunWithChats.description: A run with the tracked chats that carry the chat ID it reported.

AgentWork.title: AgentWork
AgentWork.description: Open participation an agent reports: the work, step, and the repositories it is at now.

Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: A message someone else posted in a repository's own discussion, the opening one aside.

AppliedChange.title: AppliedChange
AppliedChange.description: One change of an applied proposal that was made to the record, by its number in the proposal.

Attachment.title: Attachment
Attachment.description: An attached file's details; its bytes are read on their own.

Author.title: Author
Author.description:
Who wrote a ticket or a ticket's comment, as written then, with the avatar their agent identity
has now.

BackupPruning.title: BackupPruning
BackupPruning.description:
The rule for manual backups: the newest `keep`, and those marked to keep. Until the person
confirms it once, nothing is removed, and `candidates` lists what the rule would remove.

BackupsPruned.title: BackupsPruned
BackupsPruned.description: What confirming the rule for manual backups removed.

BaseLockRequest.title: BaseLockRequest
BaseLockRequest.description: Lock or unlock a repository's canonical base checkout read-only.

BaseLockResult.title: BaseLockResult
BaseLockResult.description: Result of locking or unlocking a repository's canonical base checkout.

Change.title: Change
Change.description: One entry of a record's history as the record's own read lists it: who changed it, how and when.

ChatAgent.title: ChatAgent
ChatAgent.description: An agent identity tied to a chat ID, by its closest tie.

ChatListed.title: ChatListed
ChatListed.description: A tracked chat as the Chats page lists it.

ChatOwner.title: ChatOwner
ChatOwner.description: The work item or roadmap a tracked chat belongs to; empty if that record is missing.

ChatStep.title: ChatStep
ChatStep.description: A step a tracked chat works on, with its status as its roadmap shows it.

ChatTrack.title: ChatTrack
ChatTrack.description:
Track the chat the calling agent registered with on a work item or roadmap, and on steps
of that roadmap. Worklog takes the chat's ID from the identity, never from the request.

ChatTracked.title: ChatTracked
ChatTracked.description: An agent's own chat as tracking it returns it: the record that tracks it, new or not.

ClaudeSession.title: ClaudeSession
ClaudeSession.description: A Claude Code session running on this machine, with the chats and agents tied to it.

Context.title: Context
Context.description: A tag: a record of one kind by its id, or a ticket by its key or number.

ContextSummary.title: ContextSummary
ContextSummary.description:
What an agent reads first, by default (audit finding P3): titles, IDs and states. The work,
plans and people by name; the latest ten updates, one line each; the day, who is at work where,
the open proposals, tickets and resources as the whole context gives them. detail=full answers
the whole context, and each record's own read its text.

ContextTag.title: ContextTag
ContextTag.description:
A record a discussion is tagged with, or that a role in it brings in, as record_kinds.summary
gives it, with who added the tag and when. A missing record has a null title.

ContextUpdate.title: ContextUpdate
ContextUpdate.description: A status update as the summary lists it: its first line, cut to CONTEXT_LINE characters.

Continuation.title: Continuation
Continuation.description: The new credential of an identity that continues in another chat.

Continued.title: Continued
Continued.description: What continuing in the new chat changed, and the roles that stay the identity's.

ContinuedChat.title: ContinuedChat
ContinuedChat.description: Where the new chat is tracked now, with the steps it holds there.

ContinuedRole.title: ContinuedRole
ContinuedRole.description: A responsibility role the identity owns, on the record its context names.

CoordinationUpdate.title: CoordinationUpdate
CoordinationUpdate.description: A status update a run posted on its participation.

CreatedStep.title: CreatedStep
CreatedStep.description: A step as step.create or step.move returns it, with its updated roadmap revision.

CredentialIssued.title: CredentialIssued
CredentialIssued.description: A credential as issuing it returns it. Its token shows only here; Worklog keeps its hash.

CredentialRotated.title: CredentialRotated
CredentialRotated.description: The credential that replaces a rotated one, for the same agent identity, with its token.

CredentialSponsor.title: CredentialSponsor
CredentialSponsor.description: The agent that registered a credential, by its label then.

DiscussedRepository.title: DiscussedRepository
DiscussedRepository.description: A repository with its own discussion's id (v22), slot summary (v34), and direct catalog dependencies (v35).

DiscussionChange.title: DiscussionChange
DiscussionChange.description: One change in the discussions feed, after the cursor it was read from.

DiscussionInbox.title: DiscussionInbox
DiscussionInbox.description: What waits on the caller and what came back to it (v33).

DiscussionRequests.title: DiscussionRequests
DiscussionRequests.description: Requests the caller sent or that have a slot for it, newest first (v33).

DiscussionResume.title: DiscussionResume
DiscussionResume.description: What an agent needs to pick up a work context's discussions: roles, threads, pending requests and a feed cursor.

DiscussionRole.title: DiscussionRole
DiscussionRole.description: A responsibility role on a work item, roadmap or step, with its owner and any pending offer.

DiscussionStarted.title: DiscussionStarted
DiscussionStarted.description: A new discussion and its first message.

DiscussionSummary.title: DiscussionSummary
DiscussionSummary.description: A discussion as lists show it: its tags and how many acknowledgement requests are pending.

DiscussionThread.title: DiscussionThread
DiscussionThread.description: A discussion with a page of its messages, oldest first.

DispatchAdvisories.title: DispatchAdvisories
DispatchAdvisories.description: Execution guardrails for overlaps and proposal review: WIP caps, freezes, re-pins, and multi-repo leaves.

DispatchCancel.title: DispatchCancel
DispatchCancel.description: Cancel a queued dispatch and its linked lease.

DispatchItem.title: DispatchItem
DispatchItem.description: A durable dispatch-time session queue entry linked 1:1 to a repository lease.

Done.title: Done
Done.description: A command that changed what it was asked to, or found nothing to change, and names nothing back.

DoneStep.title: DoneStep
DoneStep.description: A step marked done, and when it last was.

EnsuredRepository.title: EnsuredRepository
EnsuredRepository.description: A repository as registering its address returns it: the record that holds it, new or not.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: One entry of a record's history in full: the record before and after the change, as written then.

FamilyRoadmap.title: FamilyRoadmap
FamilyRoadmap.description: A roadmap above or below another, as that one lists it.

GateResolution.title: GateResolution
GateResolution.description: Who passed or waived a gate, when, and with what note or reason.

GateSummary.title: GateSummary
GateSummary.description: Counts of active pre-completion gates on one roadmap step.

GateTarget.title: GateTarget
GateTarget.description: The Worklog record a linked gate auto-evaluates against.

HashedBackup.title: HashedBackup
HashedBackup.description: A backup a person made, with its file's SHA-256.

Health.title: Health
Health.description: Whether this Worklog answers, and which instance and data it serves.

HomeRepository.title: HomeRepository
HomeRepository.description: The repository whose own discussion this is.

InboxChange.title: InboxChange
InboxChange.description: An acknowledgement, cancel, release or escalation of a request the caller manages.

Lease.title: Lease
Lease.description: A bounded repository checkout slot lease (active, offered, queued, or closed).

LeaseAcquire.title: LeaseAcquire
LeaseAcquire.description: Request a repository checkout slot lease (grants immediately or enters FIFO queue).

LeaseBindWorktree.title: LeaseBindWorktree
LeaseBindWorktree.description: Bind an active logical lease to a caller-created Git worktree.

LeasePoll.title: LeasePoll
LeasePoll.description: Refresh waiter heartbeat and confirm/provision an offered slot.

LeaseRelease.title: LeaseRelease
LeaseRelease.description: Release an active/offered lease or cancel a queued lease.

LeaseRescue.title: LeaseRescue
LeaseRescue.description: Rescue dirty changes in an expired_dirty (or active) slot and recycle it.

ListedBackup.title: ListedBackup
ListedBackup.description: A backup as Settings lists it (step 2.2).

ListedGithubReference.title: ListedGithubReference
ListedGithubReference.description: A GitHub reference as its owner lists it, with the title of the chat that made it.

LiveSnapshot.title: LiveSnapshot
LiveSnapshot.description: Everything in motion now across plans, agents, chats, discussions and repositories.

MessageActivity.title: MessageActivity
MessageActivity.description: A discussion message the agent posted.

NearbyStep.title: NearbyStep
NearbyStep.description: A step above or beside another, by its title and status.

OpenProposal.title: OpenProposal
OpenProposal.description:
An open proposal as the context lists it (K18): a draft the caller may see, or one submitted
for review, without its changes, which `proposal show` reads.

OutlineStep.title: OutlineStep
OutlineStep.description: A step as a roadmap's outline gives it: no text.

OverlapDiscussion.title: OverlapDiscussion
OverlapDiscussion.description: Another open thread tagged with a named record, where someone besides the caller wrote.

OverlapParticipation.title: OverlapParticipation
OverlapParticipation.description: Another agent's open participation in the repositories, on the work items, or on work on the steps.

OverlapTag.title: OverlapTag
OverlapTag.description: One of the named records a thread is tagged with.

Overlaps.title: Overlaps
Overlaps.description: Who else is on the named records and what they said there, leaving out the caller's own.

OwnerAgent.title: OwnerAgent
OwnerAgent.description: An agent tied to what the reference names: its profile, whether it owns it, and why.

OwnerRelation.title: OwnerRelation
OwnerRelation.description:
One thing that ties an agent to what the reference names, with its evidence; fields that don't
apply to the relation are null.

Owners.title: Owners
Owners.description:
Who owns what a reference names (v33): the records it matched, the person, and the agents tied
there, owners first.

Participant.title: Participant
Participant.description:
The person or an agent identity as they stand now: who a ticket is assigned to, or who is
on the records an overlap check names.

Participants.title: Participants
Participants.description: Everyone who can take part in a discussion: the person first, then each agent identity.

Participation.title: Participation
Participation.description: What a run reports working on: a work item, step, or none, and the repositories it works in.

ParticipationOutput.title: ParticipationOutput
ParticipationOutput.description: A pull request or commit a participation reported producing (v33).

ParticipationOutputs.title: ParticipationOutputs
ParticipationOutputs.description:
What a participation produced: pull requests by address or number, and commits by SHA, in a
repository it reports, by ID or remote; one it reports alone may be left out.

ParticipationRepository.title: ParticipationRepository
ParticipationRepository.description: A repository a participation reports working in, and where.

Person.title: Person
Person.description: A person with what they are tied to and their history.

PersonListed.title: PersonListed
PersonListed.description: A person as the people list shows them, with how many active records each kind ties them to.

PersonRecord.title: PersonRecord
PersonRecord.description: A person's own fields, as their commands return them.

PersonTie.title: PersonTie
PersonTie.description: A person's tie to a work item, roadmap or repository, as setting it returns it.

PersonUntied.title: PersonUntied
PersonUntied.description: The tie a person no longer has.

PlanRoadmap.title: PlanRoadmap
PlanRoadmap.description: A roadmap's own fields as plans.list gives them, which the context lists.

PlanStep.title: PlanStep
PlanStep.description:
A step's own fields, as a roadmap's steps and its saved revisions give them. A parent's
status is derived from its leaves.

Presence.title: Presence
Presence.description: Whether an agent can be reached, as its own reports say.

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description: A proposal as its own read returns it, with its evidence files.

ProposalEntry.title: ProposalEntry
ProposalEntry.description: A proposal as a history lists it, the latest first, with the number of its changes.

ProposalListed.title: ProposalListed
ProposalListed.description: A proposal as its writes answer it: whole, without its evidence files.

ProposalOperation.title: ProposalOperation
ProposalOperation.description: One change a proposal makes, as its create or last update checked it.

ProposalSummary.title: ProposalSummary
ProposalSummary.description:
A proposal as GET /proposals lists it: who made it, its state and dates, and the number of its
changes. Its rationale, changes and evidence come from its own read.

PullRequestActivity.title: PullRequestActivity
PullRequestActivity.description:
GET /pull-requests/activity: what reached each repository's default branch, read from its local
checkout without fetching.

Rank.title: Rank
Rank.description: revision is the item's own; a rank past the last moves the item last.

RankResult.title: RankResult
RankResult.description: A work item's stack rank after a move, 1 first, among how many ranked items.

RecordChange.title: RecordChange
RecordChange.description: One entry of a record's history: who made the change, its kind and when.

RecordHistory.title: RecordHistory
RecordHistory.description:
A record's latest history entries the reader may see: each change without its before and after,
unless one change was asked for by its ID or every one with payloads.

RecordPerson.title: RecordPerson
RecordPerson.description: A person tied to a work item, roadmap or repository, as that record lists them.

RecordSummary.title: RecordSummary
RecordSummary.description: A record by its title, and whether it is archived.

Registration.title: Registration
Registration.description: A credential an agent registered for itself, and the identity it holds.

RegistryWorkItem.title: RegistryWorkItem
RegistryWorkItem.description: A work item as the registry names it, with the roadmap its step, or it, sits on.

Repository.title: Repository
Repository.description: A repository of the catalog, as other records embed it.

RepositoryDetail.title: RepositoryDetail
RepositoryDetail.description: A repository as its own read returns it: with its discussion and the people tied to it.

RepositoryEnsure.title: RepositoryEnsure
RepositoryEnsure.description: Register a remote, or find the record that already holds it.

RepositoryMerge.title: RepositoryMerge
RepositoryMerge.description: Merge the addressed repository into `intoId`; both revisions must be current.

RepositoryResolution.title: RepositoryResolution
RepositoryResolution.description: What registering an address would do: link to the record holding its remote, or add one.

RepositorySlotSummary.title: RepositorySlotSummary
RepositorySlotSummary.description: Compact checkout slot occupancy and policy flags for lists and badges.

RequestListed.title: RequestListed
RequestListed.description: A message with an acknowledgement request, with the thread it is in.

ResourceListed.title: ResourceListed
ResourceListed.description: A resource as lists show it, without the page's text.

ResourcePage.title: ResourcePage
ResourcePage.description: A resource with its page's text, as its commands return it.

Retirement.title: Retirement
Retirement.description: An agent's own credential, retired, with how many credentials it had registered went with it.

Roadmap.title: Roadmap
Roadmap.description: A roadmap with everything its page shows.

RoadmapAttachment.title: RoadmapAttachment
RoadmapAttachment.description: An attached file in a roadmap's Material view, with its source.

RoadmapBoard.title: RoadmapBoard
RoadmapBoard.description: What a roadmap's status board reads besides the roadmap itself.

RoadmapGate.title: RoadmapGate
RoadmapGate.description: One step gate listed at the roadmap level, with step status and phase context.

RoadmapOutline.title: RoadmapOutline
RoadmapOutline.description:
A roadmap's plan without its text: each step in it, retired ones aside, depth-first in outline
order, each before its children.

RoadmapRecord.title: RoadmapRecord
RoadmapRecord.description: A roadmap's own fields, as other records embed it.

RoadmapSnapshot.title: RoadmapSnapshot
RoadmapSnapshot.description: A saved revision of a roadmap: its title, overview and steps as they stood then.

RoadmapStep.title: RoadmapStep
RoadmapStep.description: A step as its roadmap lists it, with its notes and files.

RoadmapTie.title: RoadmapTie
RoadmapTie.description: What ties a worker to a roadmap's step now, or to the roadmap itself with a null stepId.

RoadmapWorkItem.title: RoadmapWorkItem
RoadmapWorkItem.description: A work item on the roadmap or one of its steps, with the people tied to it.

RoadmapWorker.title: RoadmapWorker
RoadmapWorker.description: An agent at work on the roadmap, or a tracked chat that stands for itself.

RoleOfferOpen.title: RoleOfferOpen
RoleOfferOpen.description: A role's pending offer to another agent identity.

RosterAgent.title: RosterAgent
RosterAgent.description: An agent whose work ties it to the roadmap, now or before: one whose card names the roadmap.

RosterStep.title: RosterStep
RosterStep.description: A step still in the plan that an agent's work ties it to, with why and when.

SavedRoadmap.title: SavedRoadmap
SavedRoadmap.description:
A roadmap as its commands return it: its steps, retired ones included, and versions. The
supporting lists are always empty here; its read fills them.

SavedStep.title: SavedStep
SavedStep.description: A step as its update returns it, with its roadmap.

SessionChat.title: SessionChat
SessionChat.description: A tracked chat that follows a running session.

SlotPolicy.title: SlotPolicy
SlotPolicy.description: A repository's checkout slot policy (or effective defaults when unconfigured).

SlotPolicyUpdate.title: SlotPolicyUpdate
SlotPolicyUpdate.description: Create or update a repository's checkout slot policy.

SplitStepResult.title: SplitStepResult
SplitStepResult.description: A split leaf step and its newly created single-repo child steps.

Step.title: Step
Step.description:
A step as its own read returns it: with its roadmap, retired or not, where it sits in the plan,
and the tracked chats on it.

StepContextTag.title: StepContextTag
StepContextTag.description: A step's or a question's tag, with the roadmap it opens on.

StepCreate.title: StepCreate
StepCreate.description: revision is the roadmap's own. Inserts one step without rewriting the full tree.

StepGate.title: StepGate
StepGate.description: One pre-completion gate attached to a roadmap step, with live effective state.

StepMove.title: StepMove
StepMove.description: revision is the roadmap's own. Moves one step to another parent or position.

StepSplit.title: StepSplit
StepSplit.description: revision is the target leaf step's own. Creates single-repo child steps under it.

StepUpdate.title: StepUpdate
StepUpdate.description:
revision is the step's own. A field given replaces the step's text, repositories or work class;
one left out keeps it.

TabCounts.title: TabCounts
TabCounts.description: What a work item's tabs on Today hold, so they say so before the item is read.

Ticket.title: Ticket
Ticket.description: A ticket whole, with its latest comments and who changed it when.

TicketListed.title: TicketListed
TicketListed.description: A ticket as lists show it: its description and resolution cut to 1,000 characters each.

TicketWorkItem.title: TicketWorkItem
TicketWorkItem.description: The work item a ticket names.

TiedChat.title: TiedChat
TiedChat.description: A tracked chat whose chat ID the agent reported.

ToolsMessage.title: ToolsMessage
ToolsMessage.description: A run of tool calls between messages, as one line of activity.

Transcript.title: Transcript
Transcript.description: A tracked chat's latest transcript messages, oldest first, with its agents.

TranscriptSummary.title: TranscriptSummary
TranscriptSummary.description: A chat's agents and their latest activity, read from the tool's transcript files on this machine.

TranscriptThread.title: TranscriptThread
TranscriptThread.description: One agent's transcript in a chat: the chat itself or a subagent it started.

UnreadTranscript.title: UnreadTranscript
UnreadTranscript.description: A chat's summary when its transcript could not be read: it never fails the list.

UpdateActivity.title: UpdateActivity
UpdateActivity.description: A status update one of the agent's runs posted.

UsageDay.title: UsageDay
UsageDay.description:
One day's uses: the pages the person opened, the reads (GET) and changes (any other method) each
made, and the calls that failed.

UsageReport.title: UsageReport
UsageReport.description: Which pages and API calls were used in a window and which nothing used (usage.summary).

UsageWindow.title: UsageWindow
UsageWindow.description: The days a usage report covers, both ends included, in Worklog's timezone.

WorkContext.title: WorkContext
WorkContext.description:
What an agent reads before it starts: the day, the work, the plans, the people, the proposals,
who is at work where, and the tickets and resources.

WorkItem.title: WorkItem
WorkItem.description: A work item with everything its page shows.

WorkItemRecord.title: WorkItemRecord
WorkItemRecord.description: A work item's own fields, as other records embed it.
